## 3. Description of the Service

### 3.1 Main Functionalities

Sealmetrics provides a web analytics platform that includes:

- **Visitor tracking**: Collection of browsing data via JavaScript code
- **Analytics dashboard**: Visualization of metrics, charts and reports
- **Conversion tracking**: Recording of configurable events and conversions
- **Traffic source analysis**: Identification of the origin of visitors
- **LENS (AI Insights)**: Automatic generation of insights and recommendations
- **Conversational chat**: Assistant for querying data in natural language
- **API access**: Programmatic integration with the data
- **Data export**: Download of reports in various formats

### 3.2 Functionalities by Plan

The available functionalities vary depending on the contracted Plan. Up-to-date details are available at [sealmetrics.com/pricing](/pricing).

### 3.3 Modifications to the Service

Sealmetrics reserves the right to:

- Add new functionalities at no additional cost
- Modify existing functionalities with prior notice
- Discontinue functionalities with at least reasonable notice
- Perform scheduled maintenance with prior notice

We will notify significant changes by email and/or in the Dashboard.

## 5. Plans and Pricing

### 5.1 Available Plans

| Plan | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Agentic** (free) | Self-serve with a total human-events cap; full dashboard, pixels and MCP |
| **Growth** | Monthly/annual subscription with a monthly human-events cap; MCP, BigQuery, full API and LENS with your own key (BYOK) |
| **Scale** | Monthly/annual subscription with a higher events cap; includes managed private AI (Seal AI) with tokens included, webhooks and priority support |
| **Enterprise** | Custom annual plan: unlimited human events, exclusive private AI, isolated processing and a dedicated account manager |

Available add-on: **Private AI** (Seal AI token packs) for plans that do not include it.

Up-to-date details of each Plan are available at [sealmetrics.com/pricing](/pricing).

### 5.2 Usage Limits

Each Plan has limits on:

- Monthly or total human events (depending on the Plan)
- Access to features (Seal AI/LENS, API, BigQuery, webhooks, etc.)

Data retention is fixed and identical across all Plans (see the Retention Policy and Annex 1 of the DPA).

If you exceed your Plan's limits:
- We will notify you of the overage
- You may upgrade to a higher Plan
- Continued overage may result in restrictions of the Service

### 5.3 Plan Changes

- **Upgrade**: Effective immediately. Cost is prorated.
- **Downgrade**: Effective at the start of the next billing period.
- **Cancellation**: See Section 16 (Termination).

### 5.4 Pricing

- Prices are published on our website and may vary by Plan
- Prices do not include applicable taxes (VAT, etc.)
- We reserve the right to modify prices with reasonable notice
- Price changes do not affect the period already paid for

### 6.2 Payment Methods

### 6.4 Non-Payment

In the event of non-payment:

| Day | Action |
|-----|--------|
| 0 | Failed payment attempt, email notification |
| 3 | Second payment attempt, reminder |
| 7 | Third payment attempt, suspension warning |
| 14 | Suspension of the Service (read-only access) |

### 6.5 Billing Disputes

If you believe a charge is incorrect:

- Contact billing@sealmetrics.com within 30 days
- Provide details of the disputed charge
- We will investigate and respond within 10 business days
- If warranted, we will issue credit against future fees

### 6.6 Refunds

- No refunds are offered: amounts paid are non-refundable

### 6.7 Taxes

## 10. Data and Privacy

### 10.1 Privacy Policy

The processing of personal data is governed by our [Privacy Policy](/privacy), which forms part of these Terms.

### 10.2 Data Processing Agreement (DPA)

- Sealmetrics acts as Processor of the Analytics Data
- The Client acts as Controller
- The [DPA](https://sealmetrics.com/dpa) sets out the obligations of each party
- The DPA forms an integral part of these Terms

### 10.3 Client Obligations

As Controller, the Client must:

- Have a legal basis for the processing of Visitor data
- **Inform Visitors** in the privacy policy of each Website in accordance with clause 5.1 of the DPA:
  - using as a basis the model notice that Sealmetrics provides in the dashboard (**Settings › Privacy**);
  - including the blocks for the features it has enabled;
  - without describing the data as "anonymous"
- **Keep that information up to date**: update it within 30 days when Sealmetrics notifies it of a change to the processing, and before enabling a feature that requires additional information
- **Confirm in the dashboard** that it has made those updates. The confirmation is a statement by the Client and is recorded (user, date and version of the notice). Failure to confirm does not release the Client from its obligation
- Obtain Visitors' consent where the applicable law requires it
- Respond to Visitors' data subject rights requests
- Notify us of any instructions regarding the data

### 10.4 Use of Artificial Intelligence (LENS)

- The default AI provider is "Seal AI", operated entirely within the European Union (inference at Scaleway, Paris, with no content retention and no training on Client data)
- It works on the analytics reports (aggregated figures and breakdowns, including the values of the conversion properties configured by the Client), not on visitor profiles
- The chat conversation history is kept in the Client's Account; the application of a maximum retention period is being implemented
- If the Client connects their own key from an external provider (BYOK), that provider acts by direct designation of the Client (clause 6.1 of the DPA)
- Further information in the Privacy Policy and the DPA

### 10.5 Sub-processors

- We use sub-processors to provide the Service
- The up-to-date list is published at [sealmetrics.com/dpa](https://sealmetrics.com/dpa)
- We give notice of changes with reasonable advance notice enabling the exercise of the right to object (clause 4.3 of the DPA)

### 10.6 International Transfers

- Visitor data is processed exclusively within the European Union
- The only transfers (account users' emails) are protected by SCCs/DPF
- More details in clause 7 of the DPA

### 10.7 Security

We implement technical and organizational security measures, including:

- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and encryption of application secrets at rest
- Role-based access control
- Security monitoring and logging
- Regular backups

The detail and status of each measure are set out in Annex 2 of the DPA. Sealmetrics does not currently hold third-party certifications (such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2).

### 10.8 Security Breaches

In the event of a security breach:

- We will notify you without undue delay
- We will provide information to enable you to comply with your GDPR obligations
- We will cooperate in the management of the incident

### 10.9 Changes to the Processing and Model Privacy Notice

- Sealmetrics maintains in the dashboard a model notice for Visitors, versioned and adapted to each site's configuration, and is responsible for its technical accuracy (clause 3.6 of the DPA)
- We will notify you by email and in the dashboard of any change to the processing that affects that information, at least 30 days in advance, unless the change reduces the processing or responds to legal or security reasons
- The legal adaptation of the notice to your case and its publication are the Client's responsibility

## 16. Term and Termination

### 16.1 Term

- **Agentic Plan**: Indefinite until terminated by either party
- **Paid plans**: For the contracted period (monthly/annual), automatically renewable

### 16.2 Automatic Renewal

Paid plans renew automatically for equal periods unless:

- The Client cancels before the end of the period
- Sealmetrics gives notice of non-renewal 30 days in advance

### 16.3 Cancellation by the Client

- **Monthly plan**: You may cancel at any time. Effective at the end of the current month.
- **Annual plan**: You may cancel at any time. Effective at the end of the current year. There is no refund of remaining months.

To cancel: Settings > Subscription > Cancel, or email billing@sealmetrics.com

### 16.4 Termination by Sealmetrics

We may terminate or suspend your account:

| Reason | Notice | Effect |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Uncured material breach | 15 days to cure | Termination |
| Prohibited use | Immediate | Suspension/Termination |
| Non-payment (30+ days) | Per Section 6.4 | Termination |
| Unlawful activity | Immediate | Termination |
| Discontinuation of the Service | 90 days | Termination |

### 16.5 Effects of Termination

Upon termination:

1. **Access**: Revoked immediately (or at the end of the paid period)
2. **Data**: Available for export for 30 days
3. **Deletion**: Data deleted after 30-60 days (see Retention Policy)
4. **Billing**: Services are billed up to the termination date
5. **Outstanding obligations**: Survive termination (payments due, confidentiality, indemnification)

### 16.6 Data Export

Before deletion, you may:

- Export data from the Dashboard
- Request a full export at support@sealmetrics.com
- Use the API to extract data

### 16.7 Survival

The following sections survive termination: Definitions, Intellectual Property, Confidentiality, Limitation of Liability, Indemnification, Governing Law.
